name: MegaPro Biomedical Co., Ltd
summary: MegaPro Biomedical Co., Ltd. operates as a biotechnology enterprise primarily focused on pioneering nanodrugs. Its innovative development pipeline includes MPB-1523, an IOP injection currently in Phase II clinical evaluation for addressing hepatocellular carcinoma. Simultaneously, MPB-1514, an iron injection, is also undergoing Phase II clinical trials, targeting iron deficiency anemia. Furthermore, the firm is advancing MPB-1734, an anti-cancer pharmaceutical, which is in preclinical assessment for the treatment of malignant tumors. Established in 2014, this company is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.
